$comment: Inputs for the search-normalisation parity contract. Hand-curated; every
entry earns its place by covering a rule or a case that has actually
broken. Add to this list, then run `npm run test:fixtures` to regenerate
search-golden.json and the SQL parity script.
Expected outputs are NOT stored here on purpose -- they are generated, so
nobody hand-computes an NFKD result wrong and enshrines it.

inputs.note: the acceptance case: what the user types
runs of whitespace, leading and trailing
whitespace only -- normalises away to nothing
camel case is not a token boundary
precomposed accent -- NFKD must keep the base letter
decomposed accent -- must equal the precomposed form
ring above, plus a second accent
sharp s -- NFKD does NOT expand it to ss
Nl roman numeral -- NFKD folds it to xii, so it survives
No circled digits -- caused a 139/140 parity failure
No superscript -- NFKD folds to 2, so it survives normalize
Nd Arabic-Indic digit -- NOT folded, so it is stripped
vulgar fraction -- NFKD gives 1/2, slash then stripped
fi ligature -- NFKD splits it into f and i
Devanagari -- no a-z0-9 survives, normalises to empty
mixed script -- only the Latin part survives
emoji is not a letter or digit
an email pasted into the search box
a URL pasted into the search box
non-breaking space -- NFKD folds it to a plain space
zero-width space -- stripped, so the halves join
